prompt: I'm working on an AI-generated short film. I need a character asset for my main character: Adel, a 9 year old girl, curious type, messy dark curls, she wears a yellow raincoat in most scenes. Also in scene 3 there's a bunch of goblin minions chasing her. Can you write the image generation prompts for these character assets?
assertions: The Adel prompt explicitly specifies a gray / neutral-gray background for the character sheet
The Adel prompt requests multiple views on one sheet, including a clear face close-up AND a full-body view showing the outfit
The goblin prompt requests 3 or more distinct variations of the goblin type (different builds/heights/gear) rather than a single goblin
The response includes accept/reject QA criteria for evaluating the generated sheets (e.g., cross-view consistency, face clarity)
